findings.summary: Merge path ignored merge_policy.unsupported_claims and hard-blocked unsupported claims during merge instead of preserving them for PRD audit.
research-output-dir was documented as effort-relative but accepted traversal or absolute paths.
Durable state still showed impl-0020 planned while implementation report claimed completed work.
Re-review found research-output-dir still allowed symlinked directories to resolve outside the effort root.
Re-review found repair bookkeeping still had stale next actions and timestamps after the failed first review.
Final re-review found --merge-evidence selected merge_policy from the first sorted profile when multiple valid profiles existed instead of requiring or honoring an explicit profile.
